ik.aciklama: Staff records, leave requests and balances, the leave calendar and the weekly shift plan. Staff see their shifts and request leave from their own page.
ik.aciklamaYonetici: The agency's own staff (full management). Pick a client account to see that account's HR data read-only.
ik.yasalNot: Leave entitlements and durations come with the defaults of Turkish Labour Law No. 4857 and can be changed in Settings. For information only, not legal advice.

personel.epostaIpucu: Leave decisions and shift notifications go here.
personel.yasGrubuIpucu: Date of birth is not stored; only used for the age-based leave rule.
personel.devirIpucu: Annual leave remaining as of the balance date; half days allowed.
personel.ozelGunIpucu: Fill in if above the legal minimum; leave empty to follow the rule.
personel.veriAzaltma: Data minimisation: national ID number, date of birth, address, health and religion are not stored.
personel.araIpucu: Search name, email, position or department
personel.silOnay: Move this staff record to the bin together with its leave, shifts and documents?
personel.silindi: Staff member moved to the bin.

portal.aciklama: A personal link: they see their shifts, leave balance and history and send leave requests. Renewing or revoking the link disables the old one.
portal.gonderildi: The link was sent by email.
portal.yenilendi: A new link was created; the old one no longer works.
portal.yenileOnay: Create a new link? The old link will stop working.

csv.aciklama: The first row must be a header (comma or semicolon). Records with a matching email are updated, others are added. At most {{sayi}} rows.

izin.raporNotu: For sick leave only the date range is recorded; no diagnosis or note is written.
izin.ayniTarihte: Others off on the same dates

uyari.bakiye_yetersiz: Not enough annual leave: {{kalan}} left, {{istenen}} requested.
uyari.yasal_is_gunu: Exceeds the statutory duration in Settings ({{yasal}} working days): {{istenen}}.
uyari.yasal_takvim: Exceeds the statutory duration in Settings ({{yasal}} calendar days): {{istenen}}.
uyari.calisma_gunu_yok: No working days in this range (weekend or public holiday).
uyari.personel_ayrildi: This person appears to have left.
uyari.cakisma: two shifts at the same time.

vardiya.kopyalaUzerine: Delete this week's drafts and copy last week? (Cancel: copy into empty days only.)
vardiya.personelYok: No active staff. Add people in the Staff section first.
vardiya.uyariNotu: Warnings do not block the plan; they can be turned off in Settings.
vardiya.bildir: Notify staff by email when publishing
vardiya.geceIpucu: If the end is before the start, it ends the next day (night shift).
vardiya.yayindaDegisiklik: This shift is published; the change is announced to the employee again on the next “Publish”.
vardiya.yasalNot: Warning thresholds (11 hours of rest, 45 hours a week) are the defaults of the Turkish Working Hours Regulation and Labour Law No. 4857 Art. 63; change them in Settings. For information only, not legal advice.

ayar.firmaIpucu: Shown on the staff page, in emails and on the PDF.
ayar.calismaIpucu: Only these days count in leave calculations (tick Saturday if you work on Saturdays).
ayar.yillikAciklama: Default under Labour Law No. 4857 Art. 53: no entitlement before the first year; 1–5 years (5 included) 14 days, more than 5 and less than 15 years 20 days, 15 years and more 26 days. Accrues on each work anniversary.
ayar.yasEnAz: Minimum days for age 18 or younger / 50 or older
ayar.yasalKaynak: Statutory leave defaults: maternity 16 weeks (Art. 74), paternity 5, marriage 3, bereavement 3 days (Additional Art. 2). A warning is shown when exceeded.
ayar.vardiyaKaynak: Defaults: 11 hours of uninterrupted rest (Working Hours Regulation), at most 45 hours a week (Labour Law Art. 63).
ayar.varsayilanOnay: Reset working days, leave rules and warning thresholds to the defaults?
ayar.diniBayramNotu: Fixed national and public holidays are added automatically. Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha change every year and are not added automatically — add them below together with the eve.

sabit.genclik: Commemoration of Atatürk, Youth and Sports Day

ayar.ilkGunYarim: First day is a half day (eve)
